android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.description: Allows the app to read all data about your contacts. Malicious apps can steal your address book.

android.permission.READ_SMS.description: Allows the app to read your text messages. This can be used to steal passwords and one-time pins (OTPs).

android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.description: Tracks your precise GPS location. Unnecessary for many apps and can be used to track you.

android.permission.CAMERA.description: Allows the app to use your camera. It could be used to take pictures or record video without your knowledge.

android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.description: Allows the app to use your microphone. It could be used to record your conversations.

android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.description: Allows the app to read all files (photos, videos, documents) on your device's storage.

android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.description: Allows the app to save, modify, or delete files on your device's storage.

android.permission.INTERNET.description: Allows the app to connect to the internet. This is common, but allows data to be sent *from* your device.

android.permission.FLASHLIGHT.description: Allows the app to control the flashlight. This is normal for flashlight apps.

android.permission.WAKE_LOCK.description: Keeps the phone from sleeping. Common for media or game apps.
